name: masonry
description: Packs items of uneven height into columns with no gaps under the short ones.

attributes.name: data-min
attributes.description: The narrowest a column may be. With none, only data-columns decides the count.

attributes.name: data-columns
attributes.description: The most columns allowed. Fewer appear when the container cannot fit that many at data-min.

attributes.name: data-gap
attributes.description: Space between columns and between items.

children.description: The items. Each keeps its own height.

a11y.notes: In browsers without native masonry, items read down each column and then across. Keep the source order meaningful on its own.

guarded: grid-template-rows: masonry (add a display: grid-lanes guard when its companion properties settle)
